body.claim: root_uri is deprecated in the LSP specification and is read anyway, because a client that sends only root_uri is otherwise given the wrong workspace.
body.detail: The replacement is workspace_folders. Editors have moved at different speeds and several still send root_uri alone, so preferring the modern field and ignoring the old one would silently resolve the workspace to the process working directory — which for an editor-launched server is rarely the repository. The fallback chain is deliberate: root_uri if present, then the current directory. Remove the suppression only alongside a reading of workspace_folders, not instead of it.
